Context: 8. Pensionary terms for Central Government Employees absorbed consequent on conversion of Departments into Autonomous Body or a PSU

17. If on a, later date, the Government disinvests its equity to the extent of fifty-one percent or more, the employees' interests will be safeguarded, which includes an option for Voluntary Retirement Benefits, etc. Rule 37.
